evaluation_notes: Exact reproducibility demonstrates pipeline determinism and metric repeatability under identical inputs, not answer quality. The deterministic mock provider emits rule-based test strings without citations or NLI grounding, yielding 0.0000 citation precision/recall and 0.1000 lexical groundedness. These metrics honestly reflect the mock provider output and do not represent the performance of authentic neural models such as Ollama llama3.2.
